name: AdvancedSearchSrReconciliationProposalEngine
input: one complete published non-noop advanced_search_sr population plus stable LLD-02/03/06 readers; recovery uses identical proposal computation but acceptance remains locked by exact recovery review
identity_flow: resolve each conflict-free canonical eight-digit SR through LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportReader.get_by_official
missing identity emits sr_create_or_adopt; exact existing manual/source SR is adopted in place and service_request_id/local identity/history survive

sr_create_or_adopt for a missing identity has target_internal_id=null, target_business_id equal to the canonical eight-digit SR, medium risk, and exactly one ProposalChangeV1 ordinal 0 {field_key:'official_sr_no',change_kind:'create',value_kind:'identity',before_text:null,after_text:<canonical SR>,before_integer:null,after_integer:null,source_observation_field_id:null}
approximate descriptive evidence never selects an existing SR
source_projection_flow: compare each active field against LLD-03 current accepted source projection using field usability and source chronology
missing/unknown/malformed evidence never clears recognized truth except the explicit Current Handler blank clear, which changes no Contact
terminal entry remains source projection evidence but is split from unrelated medium-risk changes into its own high-risk sr_source_projection
terminal-to-nonterminal reversal is one high-risk single-field reviewed correction
Suspension Duration blank/zero after prior accepted nonzero is one high-risk single-field reviewed regression; no inferred duration is generated
compatible ordinary field changes may share one medium-risk sr_source_projection; each proposal freshness scope is exactly its immutable ProposalChangeV1 field-key set
customer_reconciliation: when usable Customer Account Code exists, use LLD-02 CustomerAccountCodeReviewService/ReferenceMatcher exact claimant semantics first; multiple claimants remain ambiguous
Customer Org. label is descriptive candidate evidence only and may refine/display review but never establish identity by itself
unknown/ambiguous Customer Organization never blocks otherwise valid SR source acceptance

emit sr_customer_reconciliation only for an exact bounded reviewed candidate/correction; acceptance invokes LLD-03 set_customer_from_review, which owns history-preserving SR Customer relationship and same-UoW LLD-06 consequences
contact_reconciliation: Customer Contact and Current Handler are separate source facts and candidate contexts
candidate matching uses LLD-02 ReferenceMatcher.match_contact; equal name alone never selects identity
Current Handler source projection remains text authority even if a Contact is reviewed; there is no local competing Handler string
unknown/ambiguous Contact never blocks otherwise valid SR source acceptance

sr_contact_reconciliation invokes set_customer_contact_from_review; sr_current_handler_reconciliation invokes set_current_handler_contact_reference_from_review and may resolve only the exact current accepted source observation

for current_handler_reference, the same Contact matched against a different exact current accepted Handler observation is a material evidence rebind: proposal construction may preserve Contact identity while changing only the supporting source authority; exact same Contact plus exact same support is no-change
minimal Contact creation remains a separate explicit LLD-02 command and is never an import auto-mutation

proposal_kinds.target_owner: LLD-03 source projection with LLD-06 SLA consumption

proposal_binding: observed-row proposal fingerprint binds exact source observation/field hashes/profile+registry versions/change set and target identity

sr_create_or_adopt uses exact LLD-03 SR_SOURCE_IDENTITY_BASE_V1 over {schema,official_sr_no,target}; target is null when the canonical official identity is absent and otherwise exact {service_request_id,local_sr_no,revision}. Proposal construction requires target=null. Any exact identity appearance or identity-row drift changes the token and makes the reviewed creation stale; acceptance recomputes it before receipt and exact-compares the one immutable official_sr_no create change

sr_source_projection, sr_terminal_reversal_review and sr_suspension_regression_review use exact SOMA_SR_SOURCE_FIELD_SET_BASE_V1 over the unique field_key set in immutable ProposalChangeV1 rows; empty, duplicate, identity-only or unallowlisted sets fail closed

for these field proposals, accepting disjoint fields does not change the token; changing current accepted authority of any named field does. Thus sibling review order is independent while same-field drift stales
other non-disappearance kinds retain the broader current SR/projection/reference token plus exact matcher generations/revisions required by kind

sr_customer_reconciliation encodes exactly one identity change customer_org_id with before=current customer/null, after=reviewed LLD-02 customer_org_id, integer values null, and source_observation_field_id pointing to strongest individual Customer evidence (usable Account Code preferred over Org label); fingerprint additionally binds every matcher input/source hash
customer acceptance reruns governed LLD-02 matching/current-reference checks in the writer UoW and requires the exact candidate equal encoded after; ambiguity/drift is stale
accepted Customer history uses origin_kind=advanced_search_review and immutable reconciliation_proposal_id; proposal never writes LLD-02 Customer master data or selects CPL

sr_contact_reconciliation encodes one contact_id identity change from current customer_contact/null to exact reviewed LLD-02 contact_id; source_observation_field_id is the exact usable customer_contact_label field and fingerprint binds matcher scope/all inputs

sr_current_handler_reconciliation encodes one contact_id identity change from current handler reference/null to reviewed contact; its source field points to immutable evidence underlying the exact current accepted Handler observation and may predate this run when equal text created no redundant LLD-03 observation; fingerprint separately binds current-run Handler evidence/hash and matcher inputs

for sr_current_handler_reconciliation before_text may equal after_text only when the current active handler relationship supports a different prior Handler observation; source_observation_field_id must then point to the exact current accepted Handler authority and the resulting owner mutation is a material relationship-history evidence rebind

Contact acceptance reruns LLD-02 Contact match plus LLD-03 current reference/source checks, requires the reviewed Contact remain uniquely resolved/equal after, and treats lifecycle, affiliation, matcher scope, source-pointer or Handler drift as stale; Handler acceptance also proves current-run usable label equals the accepted supporting field; accepted relationship history uses advanced_search_review and reconciliation_proposal_id without mutating LLD-02 identity/affiliation
one proposal covers the smallest independently reviewable/committable mutation scope
acceptance reruns all state-dependent identity/revision/reference/freshness checks in one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork
auto_accept: No Advanced Search reconciliation proposal is auto-accepted in Beta 1.0. Automatic reappearance is a separate bounded reconciliation of an already-reviewed warning against later positive immutable source-presence evidence and changes no imported field/ticket lifecycle authority.
closed_cross_packet_contracts: LLD-03 owns one active history-preserving SR Customer Organization relationship; source Customer labels/account code are LLD-04 evidence and LLD-02 matching inputs only.

LLD-03 owns SR customer_contact/current_handler_reference history while LLD-02 owns Contact identity/affiliation; current_handler_reference never supplies source text and is current only when bound to the exact current Handler observation.
LLD-03 sr_source_field_observations stores exact LLD-04 source_observation_field_id; LLD-04 SrSourceEvidenceProvider validates canonical SR/field/value/profile equivalence in caller UoW.

LLD-03 sr_source_presence_events owns disappearance/reappearance history; LLD-04 SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider validates population absence/presence without physical cross-packet FK or field acceptance.
LLD-06 consumes canonical SR Customer/source SLA facts through owner interfaces and never guesses Customer identity from source labels.
construction_gate: Cross-packet ownership required for Advanced Search reconciliation is exact; sequence-7 source-presence runtime persistence is implementation-ready because accepted contiguous migrations 1..6 exist.
